title: Assetto AI Director terrain scan
description: A grid of terrain measurements sampled across a track, produced by the CSP Lua scanner. Each cell records the ground height, surface normal, and whether sight to the track centreline is clear. The file is self-verifying: point count must match actual data size, station spacing must be consistent, and all values must be within plausible bounds.

schema_version.description: Incremented when a change would break an existing reader. A reader must refuse a version it does not know rather than guess at a field's meaning.

layout.description: Track layout name. Empty for tracks with a single layout.

station_count.description: Number of stations along the track.

profile_points_per_station.description: Number of lateral profile points per station.

station_spacing_m.description: Approximate distance between stations in metres.

profile_spacing_m.description: Lateral spacing between profile points in metres.

profile_range_m.description: Total lateral range from -40 to +40 metres.

total_cells.description: Expected total number of grid cells (station_count * profile_points_per_station). Must match actual grid array length.

csp_version.description: Custom Shaders Patch version that performed the scan.

grid.description: Grid cells in row-major order: stations outer loop, profile points inner loop.

station_index.description: Which station this cell belongs to (0-based).

profile_index.description: Which profile point within the station (0-based).

position_world.description: World position of this measurement point in Assetto Corsa coordinates (y up).

ground_height_m.description: Ground elevation at this point in metres (y coordinate). Null if ray:physics missed.

surface_normal.description: Surface normal vector from ray:physics. Null if measurement failed.

sight_clear.description: Whether sight line from this point to track centreline is unobstructed. Null if not measured.

sight_distance_m.description: Distance from this point to where sight ray hit track or terrain. Null if not measured.

measurement_quality.description: Quality indicator: VERIFIED (both physics and track rays succeeded), DERIVED (one succeeded with interpolation), MEASURED (raw ray data), GUESS (interpolated from neighbors), UNKNOWN (measurement failed).
